long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Wilmington to the family that established the North Carolina Reeds Jewelers business, Zimmer studied business administration at Emory University and later earned a law degree from Campbell University. He practised law before joining his brother Herbert to establish Zimmer Development Company in 1989, creating a separate property enterprise from the family's retail roots.

Zimmer has led the company as president while it developed projects across retail, multifamily and student housing markets. Its work ranges from single-tenant buildings to mixed-use town centres, with the business managing development, construction, leasing and finance from Wilmington. He continues to serve on the Reeds Jewelers board.
